as_told.title: Phone call from Captain White and indoctrination at first overseas PPD base
as_told.place_text: Overseas base in a warm climate

plain: In the early 1990s, at his first base after training, Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency (the US spy agency that listens to communications) hired him to talk with aliens, got a phone call in his dorm from his first contact officer, a Captain White. Sherman tells Michels that White gave him the name of the next person he would deal with and said he would meet that person at a set time, recognising him because "he would have his arms folded." Sherman tells it twice, and in one telling he places the base overseas in a warm climate and says he was briefed into the programme there; the story shows how, by his account, the secret programme passed him quietly from one handler to the next.
